id: Too Good to Say Goodbye Bruno Mars
folderName: Too Good to Say Goodbye Bruno Mars
setting: A park bench at night. Jake is trying to stop Emma from walking away.
lyrics:
I've made mistakes
I could have treated you better
I let you get away
There goes my happily ever after

Tell me why, why can't we try and start again?
This can't be how our story ends
You're more than my girl, you're my best friend
Tell me you remember when
I was your man and you were my girl
It was you and me against the world

Baby, ain't nobody gonna love me like the way you do
And you ain't never gonna find a love like mine
Tell me, what can I do to make it up to you?
'Cause what we got's too good to say goodbye, goodbye

Yeah, I'm still in love with you, darlin'
I know you feel the same
Oh, what's the point of both of us being broken-hearted?
I pray it's never too late

So tell me why, why can't we try and start again?
This can't be how our story ends
You're more than my girl, you're my best friend
Tell me you remember when
I was your man and you were my girl
It was you and me against the world

Baby, ain't nobody gonna love me like the way you do
And you ain't never gonna find a love like mine
Tell me, what can I do to make it up to you?
'Cause what we got's too good to say goodbye, goodbye

Girl, won't you listen?
It's you that I'm missin'
Take my hand, I wanna go, I wanna go
If we're gonna fight this fight for better days
I know we're gonna make it
This is the chance, let's take it

Baby, ain't nobody gonna love me like the way you do
And you ain't never gonna find a love like mine
Tell me, what can I do to make it up to you?
'Cause what we got's too good to say goodbye
Goodbye

conversation.speaker: A

sentences.text: Emma, could we talk before you go?
sentences.displayHtml: Emma, could we talk before you go?

conversation.japanese: エマ、帰る前に話せる？ 僕が間違えたのはわかってる。

conversation.speaker: B

sentences.text: We can talk, but I don't know if another apology will change anything.
sentences.displayHtml: We can talk, but I don't know if another apology will change anything.

conversation.japanese: 話はできるけど、また謝られても何か変わるかわからない。

conversation.speaker: A

sentences.text: I could have treated you better.
sentences.displayHtml: I could have treated you better.

sentences.text: I should have listened instead of shutting you out.
sentences.displayHtml: I should have listened instead of shutting you out.

conversation.japanese: もっと君を大切にするべきだった。遠ざけずに、話を聞くべきだったよ。

conversation.speaker: B

sentences.text: I needed to feel like we were on the same side.
sentences.displayHtml: I needed to feel like we were on the same side.

conversation.japanese: それがつらかったの。同じ側にいるって感じたかった。

conversation.speaker: A

sentences.text: What can I do to make it up to you?
sentences.displayHtml: What can I do to make it up to you?

sentences.text: I'd like to try again, if you want to.
sentences.displayHtml: I'd like to try again, if you want to.

conversation.japanese: どうしたら埋め合わせできる？ 君も望むなら、もう一度やり直したい。

conversation.speaker: B

sentences.text: I'm willing to talk, but rebuilding trust will take time.
sentences.displayHtml: I'm willing to talk, but rebuilding trust will take time.

conversation.japanese: まず今、話を聞いて。話す気はあるけど、信頼を戻すには時間がかかるよ。

lyricConnections.explanationJa: could have + 過去分詞で、過去にできたはずなのにしなかったことを振り返る。
make it up to someone は、迷惑や傷つけたことへの埋め合わせをすること。
